reason: I live in a flat in Kakkanad; the outside is the association's job, and I only need a few walls redone after the monsoon. Money isn't the issue, but I'm not paying ₹78,000 for a whole inside-and-outside package when half of it doesn't apply to me.
objection: It's all or nothing. I want someone reliable to just do the damp walls and the living room, and I don't see a partial option. I also don't know if their crew will stick to my building's strict contractor hours. If they get it wrong, the association calls me, not Turbolux.
would_change_my_mind: An interior-only or room-by-room fixed price, quoted at the site visit, with the crew committing in writing to my building's working hours and handling the association themselves.
